name: geldmacher-security
description: Reviews code for issues that can be abused in this system, and says when reachability is still unknown.

interface.shortDescription: Find issues that can be abused in this system.
interface.longDescription: Security reviews a diff, the affected code, or a repository for issues that can actually be abused here. Quick is the default. Review adds data flow and available scanners. Audit runs the six-phase method and keeps a finding confirmed only after an adversarial pass fails to disprove it.
defaultPrompt: Review the current diff for abusable issues.
Review this change and the modules it affects.
Audit this repository and disprove each finding.
